papers.title: Computationally Efficient Bayesian Learning of Gaussian Process State Space Models
papers.abstract: Gaussian processes allow for flexible specification of prior assumptions of unknown dynamics in state space models. We present a procedure for efficient Bayesian learning in Gaussian process state space models, where the representation is formed by projecting the problem onto a set of approximate eigenfunctions derived from the prior covariance structure. Learning under this family of models can be conducted using a carefully crafted particle MCMC algorithm. This scheme is computationally efficient and yet allows for a fully Bayesian treatment of the problem. Compared to conventional system identification tools or existing learning methods, we show competitive performance and reliable quantification of uncertainties in the model.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了高效的贝叶斯学习方法用于高斯过程状态空间模型，可转移至生物力学替代建模中的不确定性量化。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant/biomechanics, nor does it handle constraints or patient-specific design.

summary_en.motivation: To enable computationally efficient fully Bayesian learning in Gaussian process state space models.
summary_en.method: The approach projects the problem onto approximate eigenfunctions from the prior covariance and uses a tailored particle MCMC algorithm.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive performance and reliable uncertainty quantification compared to conventional system identification tools.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks against existing learning methods.

papers.title: String Gaussian Process Kernels
papers.abstract: We introduce a new class of nonstationary kernels, which we derive as covariance functions of a novel family of stochastic processes we refer to as string Gaussian processes (string GPs). We construct string GPs to allow for multiple types of local patterns in the data, while ensuring a mild global regularity condition. In this paper, we illustrate the efficacy of the approach using synthetic data and demonstrate that the model outperforms competing approaches on well studied, real-life datasets that exhibit nonstationary features.

llm.relevance_to_user: 与用户的研究方向（有限元代理建模、植入物设计）无直接关联，但字符串高斯过程核可能用于非平稳数据建模。
llm.why_not_core: This paper introduces a nonstationary GP kernel but does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, UQ beyond standard GP, or any biomedical/implant application.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a new class of nonstationary kernels that can capture multiple types of local patterns while maintaining global regularity.
summary_en.method: Derive covariance functions from a novel family of stochastic processes called string Gaussian processes.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms competing approaches on well-studied real-life datasets exhibiting nonstationary features.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic data and benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Generalized Spectral Kernels
papers.abstract: In this paper we propose a family of tractable kernels that is dense in the family of bounded positive semi-definite functions (i.e. can approximate any bounded kernel with arbitrary precision). We start by discussing the case of stationary kernels, and propose a family of spectral kernels that extends existing approaches such as spectral mixture kernels and sparse spectrum kernels. Our extension has two primary advantages. Firstly, unlike existing spectral approaches that yield infinite differentiability, the kernels we introduce allow learning the degree of differentiability of the latent function in Gaussian process (GP) models and functions in the reproducing kernel Hilbert space (RKHS) in other kernel methods. Secondly, we show that some of the kernels we propose require fewer parameters than existing spectral kernels for the same accuracy, thereby leading to faster and more robust inference. Finally, we generalize our approach and propose a flexible and tractable family of spectral kernels that we prove can approximate any continuous bounded nonstationary kernel.

llm.why_not_core: This paper does not apply the proposed kernels to FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle design constraints, and lacks any biomechanics or implant-related context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有谱核方法无法学习函数的可微性，且参数多，鲁棒性差。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种通用的谱核函数族，能够以任意精度逼近任意连续有界核函数。
summary_zh.result: 新核函数在相同精度下参数更少，且能控制函数可微性。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准回归数据集上对比现有的谱混合核和稀疏谱核。

summary_en.motivation: Existing spectral kernels either enforce infinite differentiability or require many parameters, limiting flexibility and robustness in Gaussian process models.
summary_en.method: A family of tractable spectral kernels is proposed that can approximate any continuous bounded positive semi-definite function, including nonstationary kernels, while allowing control over the degree of differentiability.
summary_en.result: The proposed kernels achieve comparable or better accuracy with fewer parameters than existing spectral mixture and sparse spectrum kernels.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several UCI regression datasets and compared against standard spectral kernel baselines.
